+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def eight_byte_repr(object: Any, width: int, allowance: int) -> Iterator[str]:
+    """Like ``_pytest._io.pprint._wrap_bytes_repr``, but wraps the bytes
+    repr on eight-byte word boundaries instead of four-byte ones."""
+    current = b""
+    last = len(object) // 8 * 8
+    for i in range(0, len(object), 8):
+        part = object[i : i + 8]
+        candidate = current + part
+        if i == last:
+            width -= allowance
+        if len(repr(candidate)) > width:
+            if current:
+                yield repr(current)
+            current = part
+        else:
+            current = candidate
+    if current:
+        yield repr(current)
diff --git a/testing/test_eight_byte_repr.py b/testing/test_eight_byte_repr.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..8cdc1dc27
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_eight_byte_repr.py
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from _pytest.eight_byte_repr import eight_byte_repr
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_empty() -> None:
+    assert list(eight_byte_repr(b"", 80, 0)) == []
+
+
+def test_fits_on_one_line() -> None:
+    assert list(eight_byte_repr(b"abcdefghij", 80, 0)) == ["b'abcdefghij'"]
+
+
+def test_wraps_on_eight_byte_boundaries() -> None:
+    data = bytes(range(97, 97 + 20))
+    assert list(eight_byte_repr(data, 12, 0)) == [
+        "b'abcdefgh'",
+        "b'ijklmnop'",
+        "b'qrst'",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_allowance_applies_to_last_chunk() -> None:
+    data = b"abcdefghijkl"
+    assert list(eight_byte_repr(data, 15, 0)) == ["b'abcdefghijkl'"]
+    assert list(eight_byte_repr(data, 15, 1)) == ["b'abcdefgh'", "b'ijkl'"]
+
+
+def test_invalid_input_raises() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        list(eight_byte_repr(None, 80, 0))
